title: Best flamenco in town!
text:
We booked this online before we went. We picked the 3 course dinner and show. Its absolutely worth every penny. The food is exceptional a la carte. We had our own table and could stay there seated for the whole performance.  The show was phenomenal.  The dancing is very passionate and one of the best things ive ever seen. 
Highly recommend.  
PS: was also told at a tourist info it was a very good one. They were right!
author: Jasminestorm

title: Go-Lovely and just enough
text: Go- have a drink and a quick look at Flamenco. Its just a taste but wonder performers and serving staff. Lovely location and show.
author: Kristin_W

title: Atmospheric flamenco.
text:
There are several different packages available for this experience including show and dinner, show and tapas or show and drink. We opted for the show with a drink. We were led to seats at the side of the stage and had an amazing view of the speed of the dancing. The actual flamenco show lasted an hour with three (or four?) individual dances of different tempo. The singers and guitarists were amazing too.
On reflection if you wanted more of an experience I would recommend the show with dinner as the food looked amazing. 
An atmospheric experience of flamenco in Seville. I would recommend.
author: Dena_R

title: Amazing performances
text:
Our hotel recommended Tablao El Arenal for the most authentic and traditional flamenco dancing. We loved this show! 

The Arenal restaurant is fairly small and intimate, which made the performance even more exciting. The dancing and loud foot taps reverberate in your soul.  The performers were truly incredible. It’s clear they are tenured dancers and musicians. They brought the flamenco stories to life. I was in awe at their athleticism and emotion. 

We opted not to buy the dinner package and instead buy tickets that included only a drink. You can also buy tickets that include tapas and wine
author: McWag_SF

title: Flamenco Review
text: Excellent show and performance. We really loved the venue and experience. Food and service were excellent as well.
author: Chris_M

title: Outstanding Flamenco
text: This was an outstanding show. The staff and the food were excellent and the show was performed by highly professional dancers and singers and musician. If you want to see the real Flamenco this is it.
author: Jenny_B

title: Excellent
text: Small place, I would say intimate. A very close-knit group that, while performing for their own pleasure, also gratifies the audience. Great evening.
author: Fabrizio_C
